'''Angelika van der Linde-Ploumbidis''' (Angelika van der Linde) is a statistician. She earned a Ph.D in 1982 or 1983 at the [[Free University of Berlin|Freie Universität Berlin]] with the dissertation ''Zur numerischen Behandlung von Versuchsplanungsproblemen für lineare Regressionsmodelle mit korrelierten Beobachtungen'' .<ref name="GP">{{Cite web|title=Angelika van der Linde-Ploumbidis - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=30809|access-date=2021-10-18|website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Zur numerischen Behandlung von Versuchsplanungsproblemen für lineare Regressionsmodelle mit korrelierten Beobachtungen|url=https://www.finna.fi/Record/vaari.202124|date=1982|place=Berlin|first=Angelika|last=Linde-Ploumbidis}}</ref>

In addition to her influential work in Bayesian statistical theory,<ref>{{Cite Q|Q108929214}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Q|Q108929405}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Q|Q56532420}}</ref> she works in numerical analysis,<ref>{{Cite Q|Q108931033}}</ref> probability theory and stochastic processes, geophysics and systems theory.<ref>{{Cite web|title=zbMATH Open - the first resource for mathematics: Angelika van der Linde|url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:van-der-linde.angelika|access-date=2021-10-18|website=zbmath.org}}</ref>
